question: On every Young diagram in a 4 x 4 box: is the box-betweenness base the cut system; for every outer-corner step, how many three-place knots extend the cut system, how far they reach, and which; do growth runs to 4 x 4 stay exact with order-independent totals?

definitions.step: add an outer corner p to the exact cut system of S
definitions.cover: a set of three-place knots on triples containing p, allowing every target state, excluding every other extension state
definitions.radius: the largest L1 distance from p of a knot's cells

forbidden_inputs: Changing shapes, readings, predictions or decision rules after seeing registered results
cheapest_meaningful_control: Single-row shapes, where a new line is the line's end growth (B(start, end, new)).

predictions.P1: base = cuts, d = 2 L1 on all 69
predictions.P2: new line: min 1, one single cover {opposite corner, neighbour, p}, betweenness; single cell: 0
predictions.P3: corner fill: min 3, reached at radius 2 by exactly one cover (unit square), all betweenness; parity covers

decision_rules.each prediction: holds or fails as stated in the pre-registration

stop_rule: One run; A97 status; referee hand-off; report.
